candidate.title: UMI
candidate.scope: Illumina UMI explanatory schematic for poly(A)-mRNA-derived cDNA: fragmentation, oligo(dT)-associated first-strand synthesis with a P7 arm and CCC end, second-strand-stage addition of an N10 molecular tag with Index/P5, PCR amplification, and sequence-family comparison. UMI is the sole target name. The cited droplet, immune-repertoire and single-cell applications do not expand this schematic into their complete workflows. The local sequence of operations is attributed to this drawing; primary abstracts establish the UMI principle without verifying every drawn chemistry.
